hero.label: Get Involved
hero.title: Three ways to stand with APED
hero.text: Donors, volunteers, and the communities we serve — these are the three pillars that make a nonprofit. Every form of support matters.

donate.title: Donate
donate.text: Fund education sponsorships, the health center construction, or girls' vocational training. Every contribution is tracked and reported.

volunteer.title: Volunteer / Intern
volunteer.text: APED is seeking passionate individuals for communication, donor engagement, content strategy, and international outreach. 3–6 month commitment.

partner.title: Partner With Us
partner.text: Corporate sponsors, foundations, and NGOs — we build structured win-win partnerships with transparent reporting and recognition.

volunteer_form.label: Volunteer Application
volunteer_form.title: Join our communication & donor engagement team
volunteer_form.text: Ideal for anyone passionate about nonprofit development, storytelling, and international outreach. A letter of recommendation is provided upon completion.
